II-II q.26.text: Article titles: order in charity; God more than neighbor; more than himself; himself more than neighbor; neighbor more than his own body; one neighbor more than another; better vs. more closely united; kin; son vs father; mother vs father; wife vs parents; benefactors; endures in heaven.
II-II q.26.notes: Summary. a.5: we ought to love our neighbor (his soul) more than our own body.
